summary: jannikluhn 提交通用协议内加密内存池 EIP（后编号 EIP-8105），用户的交易在打包前保持加密，防止抢跑与三明治攻击。simonmasson 的 ML-DSA 验签预编译 EIP 合并。nerolation 合并三项 EIP-7928 BAL 修改，包括把 BAL 移出执行层区块。fede_intern 称证明一个区块的成本从年初约 1.7 美元降至约一美分。

items.title_en: ethresear.ch: EIP-8077 nonce gap simulation report
items.note_en: (leobago), 22:12: a Monte Carlo study of how often one sender's consecutive blob transactions land in different shards of a sharded blob mempool; EIP-7928: remove BAL from the EL block (nerolation), submitted and merged; EIP-7907: add codesize to the account tuple and update gas per word (charles-cooper), merged after submission on November 9, 2025.

keywords_en: A universal enshrined encrypted mempool EIP submitted
the ML-DSA verification precompile EIP merged
EIP-7928 removes BAL from the EL block
EIP-7907 adds codesize to the account tuple
proving a block costs about a cent
summary_en: jannikluhn submitted the universal enshrined encrypted mempool EIP (later EIP-8105): transactions stay encrypted until included, blocking frontrunning and sandwiching. simonmasson's ML-DSA verification precompile EIP merged. nerolation merged three EIP-7928 BAL changes, including removing BAL from the EL block. fede_intern said proving a block fell from about $1.70 at the start of the year to about one cent.
